text: AEMEATH Theme（DSH 插件，Web 主题）：为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换上樱花粉紫风格，提供「樱花晨光」浅色和「樱夜」深色配色。插件通过覆盖 --dsw-* 设计令牌联动调整背景、文字、按钮、边框和代码块颜色，并加入对话背景立绘、侧边栏 Q 版徽章及像素海豹 favicon，同时设置页面标题。客户端将内联样式挂入页面，host 部分提供本地主题图片路由。适合希望整体改变 DSH Web 外观并使用插画装饰的用户；安装后刷新或重启对应 Web profile 生效。无需 API key 或外部账号。

AEMEATH Theme restyles DSH Web with Sakura Dawn light and Sakura Night dark palettes. It changes interface colors and adds chat art, a sidebar badge, favicon and page title. The client injects the stylesheet; the host serves artwork locally. No API key or external account is required.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成樱花粉紫配色。
DSH Web 能不能同时适配浅色和深色主题？
Can I give my DSH web interface a coordinated theme with custom colors and artwork?
AEMEATH Theme 的功能「浅深双主题配色」：客户端插件把覆盖整套 --dsw-* 设计令牌的样式表加入 DSH Web 页面，提供樱花晨光浅色方案和樱夜深色方案，随界面深色标记切换。安装并启用插件后刷新页面生效。
AEMEATH Theme 的功能「插画与站点标识」：主题为对话区加入背景立绘、为侧边栏加入 Q 版徽章，并替换 favicon 和页面标题；host 部分通过本机的 /aemath-assets/ 路由提供主题图片。
dsh-theme-aemath 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 29 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 爱弥斯主题 · AEMEATH Theme：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

渐湖边暮色里的樱花瓣，带一点虚质空间的幽光——为 **DeepSeek Harness Web** 做的紫罗兰玫粉主题。

- **全局换装**：浅色「樱花晨光」/ 深色「樱夜」两套配色，覆盖整套 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌，不是只换一个主色
- **主题色**：紫罗兰玫粉 `#963f86`（浅色）/ `#c96f9e`（深色），按钮、链接、选中态、滚动条、代码块全部联动
- **对话背景立绘**：立绘处理成淡彩后作为对话区背景层（全屏固定层 + 左侧遮罩淡出，不依赖任何带构建 hash 的组件类名）
- **Q 版徽章**：左下角圆形小头像，白圈 + 紫粉描边 + 柔光
- **favicon 与标题**：飞行雪绒·像素海豹 favicon，页面标题改为 `DeepSeek Harness - AEMEATH Theme`
- **零请求**：样式表、立绘、favicon 全部内联在插件里，不向外要任何资源
dsh-theme-aemath README · 安装：主题是一个**客户端插件**（client plugin），装完刷新页面即可见效。
dsh-theme-aemath README · 方式一：从插件市场：设置 → **插件市场** → 搜索 `aemath`（或「爱弥斯」）→ 一键安装 → 刷新页面。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 方式二：命令行（`dsh web` 的 web profile）：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-aemath
```

装完 **重启 `dsh web`**。
section: 方式二：命令行（`dsh web` 的 web profile）

dsh-theme-aemath README · 方式三：手动启用（装的是本地目录 / 压缩包时）：包已经在 profile 里、只是还没被加载时，往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
（`~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`）加一条 insert：

```yaml

    - id: ui-theme-aemath
      name: 'dsh-theme-aemath'
```

然后重启 `dsh web`。

> 桌面客户端（Electron）读的是 **`desktop` profile**，`dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。
> 在桌面端要让 DSH 自己装：直接在会话里说「装一下 dsh-theme-aemath」。
section: 方式三：手动启用（装的是本地目录 / 压缩包时）

text:
dsh-theme-aemath README · 关掉主题：三种都行，选一个：

```yaml

dsh-theme-aemath README · ~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml：- id: ui-theme-aemath
  disabled: true
```

或者把上面那条 insert 注释掉，或者在设置 → 插件里热禁用。重启 / 热重载后
主题消失，界面回到出厂配色——插件不会残留任何注入。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 生效范围：主题覆盖的是 **配色令牌 + 两个装饰层**，不动任何组件结构：

| 覆盖的东西 | 怎么实现的 |
| --- | --- |
| 全部 `--dsw-*` 令牌 | `html body` 下重定义，浅深两套靠 `[data-ds-dark-theme]` 切换 |
| 对话区背景立绘 | `html body::before`，`z-index: 50`（在内容层之上、弹层之下），`pointer-events: none` |
| 左下角 Q 版徽章 | `html body::after`，`z-index: 999`，`pointer-events: none` |
| favicon / 页面标题 | 客户端插件在 `ctx.effect` 里换，卸载即还原 |

因为它只用到 `body` 上的伪元素和 CSS 变量，**前端升级换了构建 hash 也不会失效**——
这是刻意的：主题以前把图放进 dist，dsh 一升级就被还原，踩过一次。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 微调：想改的话，直接改 `src/aemath-theme.css` 顶部的几个变量：

```css
--aemath-art-opacity: 0.42;   /* 背景立绘强度：越高越明显，也越"蒙" */
--aemath-chibi-size: 96px;    /* Q 版徽章尺寸 */
--aemath-chibi-left: 92px;    /* 徽章水平位置（侧边栏宽 - 尺寸）/ 2 */
--aemath-chibi-bottom: 170px; /* 徽章离底距离 */

改完重建：

```powershell
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

重建是幂等的、可复现的：背景图按内容哈希 stamp 缓存标记，Q 版内联为 data URI，
favicon 内联为 SVG data URI。`lib/client.js` 是构建产物，别手改。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 换立绘：1. 新的背景图存成 `assets/aemath-bg.jpg`（建议 1600px 宽、JPEG 质量 80 上下，
   主题会把它压到 `--aemath-art-opacity` 的透明度当水印用）
2. 新的 Q 版小图存成 `assets/aemath-chibi.jpg`（正方形，会被裁成圆形）
3. `node scripts/build-client.mjs`

> 本仓库内置的立绘为作者自有素材。**替换/二次分发前请确认你拥有所用图片的权利。**

dsh-theme-aemath/
├── package.json            # dsh.client.platform = web

dsh-theme-aemath README · 自检：改完东西、发布之前跑一次：

```powershell
node scripts/self-check.mjs
```

63 项检查：包清单（name / version / exports / `dsh.client.platform` / files 白名单）、
素材是不是真的 JPEG、`lib/client.js` 能不能被客户端加载器上下文执行、`apply()` 有没有
真的把样式表挂进 `document.head`、favicon 有没有换成功、host 路由对目录穿越和非法
方法返回什么、产物里有没有残留本机绝对路径。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 上架：插件市场的条目来自 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
精选列表（市场本身不维护清单）。从这台机器到上架要走的三步——npm 发布、
GitHub 仓库、提 PR——都写在 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) 里，包含命令和坑。

dsh-theme-aemath README · 素材路由：host 半边只做一件事：开一条 `/aemath-assets/*`。

- 只提供 `assets/` 里 **`aemath-` 前缀**的文件，目录成分一律丢掉——`..`、绝对路径、编码穿越都进不来
- 只接受 `GET` / `HEAD`
- 素材目录**相对模块自身**解析，不写死绝对路径，所以 `node_modules` 安装和 `link:.` 开发安装都能找到图
- 带 `?v=<内容哈希>`，换图立刻生效
dsh-theme-aemath README · 许可：MIT。主题是非官方同人作品，与《鸣潮》/ 库洛游戏无关。

dsh-theme-aemath README · AEMEATH Theme for DeepSeek Harness：[中文说明 / Chinese README](README.md)

Sakura petals at dusk by the Fading Lake, with a faint glow of the Void — a violet-rose theme for the **DeepSeek Harness Web** GUI.

dsh-theme-aemath README · AEMEATH Theme for DeepSeek Harness：- **Full reskin**: a light "Sakura Dawn" and a dark "Sakura Night" palette, covering the whole `--dsw-*` design-token set — not just a swapped primary colour
- **Brand colour**: violet-rose `#963f86` (light) / `#c96f9e` (dark), wired through buttons, links, selection, scrollbars and code blocks
- **Conversation background art**: the key art, processed into a soft watermark behind the chat column (a fixed full-screen layer faded out by a left-edge mask — no dependency on any build-hashed component class name)
- **Chibi badge**: the round avatar at the bottom-left, with a white ring, violet outline and soft glow
- **Favicon and title**: the *Flying Snowfluff* pixel seal as favicon, page title `DeepSeek Harness - AEMEATH Theme`
- **Zero requests**: stylesheet, key art and favicon are all inlined — the plugin fetches nothing
dsh-theme-aemath README · Install：This is a **client plugin**: it takes effect on a page refresh.
dsh-theme-aemath README · From the plugin market：Settings → **Plugin Market** → search `aemath` → one-click install → refresh the page.

dsh-theme-aemath README · CLI (`dsh web`'s web profile)：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-aemath
```

Then **restart `dsh web`**.

dsh-theme-aemath README · Manual enable (local directory or tarball install)：If the package is already in the profile but not loaded yet, add an insert entry to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-theme-aemath
      name: 'dsh-theme-aemath'
```

Then restart `dsh web`.

> The Electron desktop client reads the **`desktop` profile**, and `dsh plugin` does not touch it by design. There, let DSH install it from inside a desktop session — just ask: "install dsh-theme-aemath".
section: Manual enable (local directory or tarball install)

text:
dsh-theme-aemath README · Disable it：Any one of these:

```yaml

dsh-theme-aemath README · ~\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml：- id: ui-theme-aemath
  disabled: true
```

…or comment out the insert entry, or hot-disable it from Settings → Plugins. The theme disappears and the stock palette comes back; the plugin leaves nothing injected behind.
dsh-theme-aemath README · What it touches：Only colour tokens and two decorative layers. No component structure is modified:

dsh-theme-aemath README · What it touches：| Covered | How |
| --- | --- |
| Every `--dsw-*` token | redefined under `html body`, light/dark switched by `[data-ds-dark-theme]` |
| Conversation background art | `html body::before`, `z-index: 50` (above content, below overlays), `pointer-events: none` |
| Chibi badge (bottom-left) | `html body::after`, `z-index: 999`, `pointer-events: none` |
| Favicon / page title | swapped inside the client plugin's `ctx.effect`; restored on unload |

dsh-theme-aemath README · What it touches：Because it relies only on `body` pseudo-elements and CSS variables, **a frontend upgrade that changes build hashes cannot break it**. That is deliberate: the theme used to ship art into the frontend `dist`, which an upgrade restores — it has failed that way once already.

dsh-theme-aemath README · Tweaking：Edit the variables at the top of `src/aemath-theme.css`:

```css
--aemath-art-opacity: 0.42;   /* background art strength */
--aemath-chibi-size: 96px;    /* badge size */
--aemath-chibi-left: 92px;    /* badge x-offset: (sidebar width - size) / 2 */
--aemath-chibi-bottom: 170px; /* badge bottom offset */

Then rebuild:

```powershell
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

dsh-theme-aemath README · Tweaking：The build is idempotent and reproducible: the background art is cache-stamped by content hash, the chibi is inlined as a data URI, the favicon as an SVG data URI. `lib/client.js` is a build artefact — do not hand-edit it.

dsh-theme-aemath README · Swapping the artwork：1. Save the new background as `assets/aemath-bg.jpg` (about 1600px wide, JPEG quality ~80; the theme renders it as a watermark at `--aemath-art-opacity`)
2. Save the new chibi as `assets/aemath-chibi.jpg` (square; it is cropped into a circle)
3. `node scripts/build-client.mjs`

> The bundled artwork is the author's own material. **Check that you hold the rights to any image you substitute or redistribute.**

dsh-theme-aemath README · Layout：```
dsh-theme-aemath/
├── package.json            # dsh.client.platform = web
├── lib/                    # shipped code (built + hand-written)
│   ├── client.js           #   browser half: the whole stylesheet inlined (build output)

dsh-theme-aemath README · Self check：Before publishing, run:

```powershell
node scripts/self-check.mjs
```

63 assertions: package manifest (name / version / exports / `dsh.client.platform` / `files` allowlist), that every image really is a JPEG, that `lib/client.js` executes in the client loader context, that `apply()` actually mounts the stylesheet into `document.head`, that the favicon is swapped, what the host route answers to traversal and bad methods, and that no machine-local absolute path survived into the artefacts.

dsh-theme-aemath README · Publishing：Market entries come from the curated [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) list (the market itself keeps no catalogue). The three steps from this machine to a listing — npm release, GitHub repo, PR — are in [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md), commands and pitfalls included.

dsh-theme-aemath README · Asset route：- Serves only `aemath-`-prefixed files inside `assets/`, with every directory component stripped — `..`, absolute paths and encoded traversal cannot get in
- `GET` / `HEAD` only
- The asset directory is resolved **relative to the module itself**, never as a hard-coded absolute path, so both a `node_modules` install and a `link:.` dev install find their own art
- Carries `?v=<content hash>`, so swapping an image takes effect immediately
